speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — breaker and uncoverer?
premises: Bow to you who, having manifested the becoming-agitated delusion, breaks.
To knowledge-bliss, nondual — O god, having covered, to uncoverer.
inference: Bow to breaker and uncoverer of delusion, knowledge-bliss nondual.
uncertainties: Obscure syntax — literal only; bhindate/vivṛṇvate datives, vṛtvā covering.

option_choices.reason: To-breaker (agent breaking delusion); for-breaking purpose is same act, T1 kept.
Having-covered (manifesting then covering); enclosed is same vṛ, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (pleading protection)
question: Who protects from māyā?
premises: By which wishes could her end-distinction be reached.
Stealing māyā in one wink — may that Śiva protect us.
inference: May Śiva who steals māyā in a wink protect us.
uncertainties: yasyāḥ antecedent māyā open; paryantaviśeṣaḥ end vs limit.

option_choices.reason: End-distinction (reachability of her end); limit is same paryanta, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (acknowledging lordship)
question: Who is lord of dispassion, knowledge, desirelessness?
premises: Weighty course of dispassion, supreme glory of knowledge, highest peak of desirelessness.
Of bearing these, you, O lord, are lord.
inference: You bear dispassion, knowledge, desirelessness: you are lord.

option_choices.reason: Course (way of dispassion); goal is same gati, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (questioning measure)
question: How great are you?
premises: Even of Brahmā you are Brahmā; of whom are you not lord, O lord of lords.
World-welfare's welfare, how great you are — who knows?
inference: Lord of lords beyond measure — who knows how great?

option_choices.reason: Of-Brahmā (god, with Brahmā predicate); absolute brahman is same word, T1 god kept.

speaker: Devotee (renouncing kin)
question: What use kin and masters?
premises: What with other kin, what with friends and masters likewise.
In every place, my lord, you lift from the becoming-ocean.
inference: No kin or master; you alone lift everywhere.

speaker: Devotee (exulting nectar)
question: What drops conquer?
premises: Victorious drops of divine nectar.
Drawn by Śaiva-yoga power, able to wash delusion-māyā stain. (Kṣemarāja skips the śaivayoga allusion — elucidated, not smoothed.)
inference: Śaiva-yoga-drawn nectar drops conquer, washing stain.

option_choices.reason: Victory-exclamation (jayanti); finite they-conquer is same victory, T1 kept.
Drops (vipruṣ as drops); sprinklings is same scattering, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (chanting Gāyatrī)
question: Who impels thoughts on the true path?
premises: By Gāyatrī is sung whose thought-radiance impelling.
May he impel, I hope, our thoughts on the true path, the lord.
inference: May Gāyatrī-sung impeller guide thoughts truly.

speaker: Devotee (begging standing)
question: Will you not make standing?
premises: O eight-formed, in even one form will you not make eternal standing for us.
Or pleased, you will do all.
inference: Make eternal standing in one form; pleased, do all.

speaker: Devotee (trusting name)
question: What gives liberation?
premises: Reality-principle of categories generally effects purpose.
But yours, O lord, even the name gives accomplishment up to liberation.
inference: Things effect purposes; your name gives liberation.

speaker: Devotee (marveling at power)
question: Who is not amazed at your power?
premises: Again and again, to arrange each next state of the world-picture.
By that power of yours, O lord, what mindful one is not amazed?
inference: Your ever-arranging power amazes every mindful one.

option_choices.reason: To-arrange (each next state set); conceive/infer is same ūh, T1 arrange kept; hyphen token byte-exact.
